rooms.label: Market square
rooms.reads_as: a market square or marketplace: covered stalls with striped awnings in rows round a monument, well or fountain, wares set out on tables and on the ground

rooms.label: Town street
rooms.reads_as: a town or village street: a cobbled way with street lamps, bollards, a bench, barrels, shop signs

rooms.label: General store
rooms.reads_as: a general store / village shop: a shop counter with shelves of mixed goods behind it, bins of dry goods, sacks, barrels and pots

rooms.label: Bakery
rooms.reads_as: a bakery: a shop counter and shelves of bread, a bread oven, racks of loaves, flour sacks

rooms.label: Apothecary
rooms.reads_as: an apothecary / herbalist / potion shop: a counter, a cabinet of many small drawers, shelves of bottles and jars, herbs

rooms.label: Tailor & draper
rooms.reads_as: a tailor's or draper's shop: bolts of coloured cloth on shelves, dress forms with gowns, a cutting table, a mirror

rooms.label: Magic & curio shop
rooms.reads_as: a magic shop / curiosity shop: a counter and shelves of strange objects (crystal ball, skulls, crystals, scrolls), a display case, a telescope or globe

rooms.label: Shop back room
rooms.reads_as: a store room / stock room behind a shop: shelving, crates, barrels and sacks, a small desk with a ledger

rooms.label: Shop passage & stair
rooms.reads_as: a hallway, corridor or passage of a house

rooms.label: Watch post
rooms.reads_as: a town watch post / guard house / jail office: a desk, a small barred lockup cell in a corner, weapon racks, wanted posters

rooms.label: Town house: living room
rooms.reads_as: the living room or main room of an ordinary house: a fireplace with seats by it, a dining table with chairs, a dresser or cupboard

rooms.label: Town house: bedroom
rooms.reads_as: a bedroom: a bed with bedside tables, a washstand, a chest
